hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Upper slips
function: The segmented ring above the element that holds the plug against pressure from below and keeps the element compressed.

tabs.overview: Set after the lower slips as the sleeve continues to stroke; holds the stack together once the setting tool releases.
